summary: Full backend + frontend test of Ashtech Pay extension to Ads and Special Tasks. Backend pytest suite: 29/29 PASS (6 new ads/tasks + 10 activation + 13 izichange). Frontend: fresh test user registered → /pay-ashtec?kind=ads&target_id=…&amount=5000&title=Test+Publicité renders exactly as spec — header 'Test Publicité' + amount '5 000 FCFA' + 14 XOF/XAF country chips (GN & CD absent) + operator chips revealed on country select (T-Money + Flooz for TG) + payash-phone input + payash-submit button showing '🚀 PAYER 5 000 FCFA' + payash-back visible. Regression: activation-ashtec still locked at 2 500 FCFA with 14 country chips, no GN/CD. All required test IDs present.
critical_code_review_comments: pay-ashtec.tsx: uses `catalog` from /payments/ashtec/catalog (auth=false) which is fine. However the countdown/verify_payment loop shares the same sandbox-flake issue reported in iteration_35 (first status poll may resolve to 'failed' in Ashtech sandbox). Consider grace window on first poll to preserve UX.

ad-create.tsx L136-147: PayInit type declares method as 'crypto' only; when in future mobile_money returns from /pay it'd break the type. Since Mobile Money now navigates AWAY to /pay-ashtec instead, this is fine for now but worth a comment.
special-task-create.tsx: `confirmPayment` function (L99-108) is defined but no longer wired to any button — dead code after Ashtec Mobile Money migration; safe to remove.

pay-ashtec.tsx L86-89: operator auto-select useEffect depends on `selectedCountry` object identity — memo will recompute on every catalog change but works correctly. Minor: could add `operator` to deps to avoid the missing-dep lint warning.
